header: TELLING THE DEVELOPER (22 Nov 2026). There is one outgoing channel, off until I set it: ERROR_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL, a web address that accepts a JSON POST (Slack, Teams, Discord, ntfy, a Telegram bridge, a mail relay's webhook ...). The body is {"text": "...", "content": "..."} (two names for one text, so the common services all read it). The notice is short and made of masked text only (scrub.ts): the rank, the count, the page's path, the first line of the masked message and the log id; never a ticket, a name, an address or a stack. Until the address is set nothing leaves the application and I read the log with `npm run errors`. The closed intranet has no mail or SMS gateway yet (see the security assessment, decision on OTP); when it has, this is the one place to add it.

symbols.name: sendAlert
doc: Posts the notice; returns false when no address is set or the service did not accept it. Never throws, and I wait at most 5 seconds.
